subject: AmigaDOS Execute dot-command preprocessing
observations: A script whose first line is a dot command is scanned for substitutions before dispatch and uses a temporary file in T:.
The documented delimiter example places .BRA and .KET after an earlier ECHO while explaining substitution using the changed delimiters.
KEY, DOT, BRA, KET, DOLLAR and DEF have the documented directive roles and the DOT/DOLLAR/BRA/KET arguments are one character.
implementation_consequence: CopperOS must prepare an eligible script into runner-owned temporary input before executing any command line. The manual's delimiter example is not sufficient to infer retroactive delimiter behavior; the hash-bound Workbench fixture execute-wb31-late-brackets.json establishes source-ordered directive application.
limits: This source is documentation evidence and is not a hash-bound execution of the original Workbench 3.1 binary.
Original WB 3.1 and MorphOS fixtures must still establish exact diagnostics, temporary-file names, cleanup, failure status and IoErr.
